description: Where does this x402 pay-to address sit? An address brief on its listings in this week's Bazaar (category, price, payers and calls, the price's percentile in its category, repeat use, Fair Offer block) and the categories it sells in (repeat demand this week against last, and the address's share). Markdown, every table also as JSON; the contents are free. Price: $0.25 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.25 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
